documentation.range: Known as the "living fossil", this species occurs in the Indo-West Pacific in the vicinity of the Grand Comoro and Anjouan islands, the coast of South Africa, Madagascar, and Mozambique.
documentation.habitats: L. chalumnae is a nocturnal hunter, sheltering within caves throughout the day and foraging at night on squid and other fish species.
documentation.measures: It is listed on CITES Appendix I

description.en: Marine Neritic - Subtidal Rock and Rocky Reefs
